questions.q: An email is marked "For your information" and contains no request or instruction. Which interpretation is supported by that wording alone?
options: The message shares information without expressly asking the recipient to carry out an action.
The recipient has expressly been assigned approval of the information.
The recipient has expressly been asked to send the information to a customer.
The recipient has expressly been given a deadline to correct the document.
questions.explanation: For your information signals the informational purpose. It does not alone assign approval, forwarding or correction.

questions.q: You need a copy of a missing invoice, but your draft says “Please pay invoice INV-042”. What action does the draft incorrectly request?
options: Cancellation of the invoice rather than transmission
Payment rather than transmission of the document
Transmission rather than payment of the document
Approval of the annual accounts rather than payment
questions.explanation: Please pay demande un règlement. Pour obtenir une pièce manquante, il faut demander send a copy, sans créer une demande de paiement involontaire.

questions.q: A payment record omits the currency. You want the sender to clarify that missing detail. Which question is appropriately targeted?
options: Could you confirm the total number of supplier invoices?
Could you confirm that every invoice has been paid?
Could you confirm the currency of the payment?
Could you confirm that the payment was definitely in euros?
questions.explanation: The request "Could you specify the currency used for this amount?" asks directly for the missing currency. It does not assume a currency or request a different piece of information.

questions.q: A delivery message refers to “the revised schedule”, but two schedules are circulating. Which reply seeks clarification without inventing an agreement?
options: Thank you for confirming that both schedules are approved.
We confirm that the earlier schedule has been cancelled.
We assume that the latest file name proves final approval.
Could you identify the version of the schedule you are referring to?
questions.explanation: La question identifie l’ambiguïté et demande une référence de version. La circulation d’un fichier ne démontre ni son approbation ni l’annulation des autres versions.

questions.q: Which sentence correctly asks someone to give advice on an invoice discrepancy?
options: Could you advise us on the invoice discrepancy?
Could you advice us on the invoice discrepancy?
Could you an advice on the invoice discrepancy?
Could you advising us on the invoice discrepancy?
questions.explanation: Advise est le verbe ; advice est un nom. Après could you, la base verbale advise convient pour demander un conseil ou une indication.

questions.q: In an email, the supplier says "We will issue the invoice tomorrow". Which action does issue mean in this context?
options: Pay the invoice already owed by the customer.
Prepare and send the invoice as a billing document.
Cancel the invoice and release the customer from the charge.
Reconcile the customer’s bank account with its own records.
questions.explanation: To issue an invoice means to create or send it as a billing document. It differs from settling, cancelling or reconciling a payment.

questions.q: An email opens "Further to our call yesterday, I am sending the revised quotation". What relationship does this opening establish?
options: The email requests a new call before any quotation can be sent.
The email states that the quotation was approved during the call.
The email follows up on the earlier call.
The email cancels what was discussed in the earlier call.
questions.explanation: Further to refers back to an earlier exchange and introduces a follow-up. It does not itself establish approval, cancellation or a requirement for another call.

questions.q: An email with a customer-specific attachment is addressed to a different customer. Which check directly addresses the disclosure risk?
options: Verify only that the file opens correctly on the sender’s computer.
Verify the file version while assuming that the address is correct.
Verify encryption while assuming that the recipient is authorised.
Verify that both the recipient and file match the intended customer.
questions.explanation: La cohérence destinataire-fichier protège la confidentialité de l’envoi. Un contrôle technique, de version ou de chiffrement ne corrige pas l’envoi au mauvais client.

questions.q: A recipient says the promised attachment is missing. You verify that no file was attached. Which reply is accurate?
options: Thank you for flagging this; I am sending the missing file with this reply.
The mention of an attachment in my previous email confirms that the file was delivered despite its absence.
Please use the previous message itself as the file, even though it did not contain the document.
The absence of the file confirms that no supporting document is needed for the requested review.
questions.explanation: La réponse reconnaît le constat vérifié et annonce une action concrète. Mentionner une pièce jointe dans le texte ne prouve pas sa transmission effective.

questions.q: Which subject line best describes an email whose sole purpose is to ask for a revised quotation for maintenance contract M12?
options: Confirmation of accepted quotation — maintenance contract M12
Request for revised quotation — maintenance contract M12
Payment received — maintenance contract M12
Notice of contract cancellation — maintenance contract M12
questions.explanation: The subject should state the requested commercial action. Asking for a revised quotation is not accepting a price, confirming a payment or cancelling the contract.

questions.q: A colleague receives an updated draft and assumes it replaces an approved version without authorisation. Which email wording best prevents that mistake?
options: The new draft supersedes the approved version solely because it was circulated more recently.
Please implement the proposed changes immediately while the draft is still awaiting approval.
This file is a draft for review; the approved version remains in force pending confirmation.
Please treat this draft for comment as the approved operative version until someone rejects it.
questions.explanation: Une date récente ne suffit pas à modifier le statut d’un document. La formulation distingue clairement la revue du brouillon et le maintien de la version approuvée.

questions.q: An instruction says "Respond within three working days of receipt". Which event starts the stated response period?
options: The end of the third working day after receipt.
The date on which the recipient chooses to prepare the reply.
The date on which the reply is finally approved, regardless of receipt.
Receipt of the message or document covered by the instruction.
questions.explanation: Of receipt anchors the period to receipt, rather than the start or completion of the recipient’s internal work. A specific working-day calendar may still need clarification if relevant.

questions.q: A meeting is moved from Friday to Wednesday of the same week. Which phrase accurately describes the change?
options: The meeting has been brought forward.
The meeting has been postponed.
The meeting has been extended until Friday.
The meeting has been cancelled without a replacement date.
questions.explanation: Bring forward means move to an earlier time or date. Postpone moves later; extending concerns duration and cancellation does not describe the replacement date here.

questions.q: You need the supplier to confirm the delivery date by Tuesday, but delivery itself need not take place by then. Which request expresses this correctly?
options: Please deliver the goods by Tuesday.
Please confirm the delivery date by Tuesday.
Please confirm that the goods were delivered by Tuesday.
Please send the confirmation only when the goods are delivered on Tuesday.
questions.explanation: The deadline applies to confirming the date, not to delivery itself. The other requests require, assume or wait for delivery by or on Tuesday.

questions.q: Which completion correctly follows "We would rather ___ the revised quotation before approving the purchase"?
options: receiving
to receive
receive
received
questions.explanation: Would rather is followed by the bare infinitive when the same subject expresses its preference: would rather receive.

questions.q: A supplier has missed a previously agreed response deadline. You need an updated schedule. Which request is most useful?
options: Could you reconfirm the missed original date without proposing when a response can now be provided?
Could you confirm the invoice amount instead of the response timing that remains unresolved?
Could you close the request as completed because its previous deadline has passed?
Could you confirm when you can provide the response and identify any blocking issue?
questions.explanation: Une nouvelle date et l’identification du blocage permettent de planifier la suite. La relance ne doit ni nier le retard constaté ni lui attribuer automatiquement un effet juridique.

questions.q: An assistant writes "I am contacting you on behalf of the finance director". What does on behalf of indicate?
options: The assistant is communicating as a representative of the finance director.
The assistant is contacting the director rather than the recipient.
The assistant is communicating against the director’s stated position.
The assistant is merely copying the director into the email and expressly denies representing the director.
questions.explanation: On behalf of identifies the person or body represented. It does not by itself establish the details of approval authority or a financial transaction.

questions.q: Your records show invoice 53 unpaid, but the customer may have paid without a matching reference. Which follow-up is factual?
options: We confirm the invoice remains unpaid by your bank, although we have checked only our unmatched records.
Our records do not yet show payment for invoice 53; could you confirm its status?
Your message is treated as confirmation that our unmatched record is a deliberate refusal to pay.
Please make a second payment before we investigate whether your earlier transfer can be matched.
questions.explanation: La formule rapporte l’état des enregistrements et demande une confirmation. Elle évite d’attribuer une intention au client ou d’annoncer un encaissement non vérifié.

questions.q: A customer disputes one line of an invoice. You need to identify the disputed item before reviewing it. Which response is appropriate?
options: We will review only the invoice total, without identifying the line you dispute.
We will treat the unspecified line as settled because the other lines are undisputed.
Could you identify the line and explain the difference you have noted?
We will correct every line to the same amount before identifying the discrepancy you report.
questions.explanation: La demande vise les faits nécessaires à l’examen du désaccord. Elle ne transforme pas la contestation en preuve automatique, ni en acceptation intégrale.

questions.q: A customer says payment was made yesterday, but your bank reconciliation cannot match it. Which request most directly provides the transaction identifiers?
options: Could you resend the original invoice without any payment details?
Could you confirm next month’s planned invoice payment date?
Could you restate the general payment terms without transaction details?
Could you send the payment date, amount and transaction reference?
questions.explanation: La date, le montant et la référence permettent de rapprocher le versement. L’ancienne facture, un paiement futur ou les conditions générales ne décrivent pas ce règlement précis.

questions.q: A recipient replies “Thank you, we received your reminder”. Which conclusion is justified by that reply alone?
options: The reminder was received.
The invoice has been paid.
The amount has been accepted without reservation.
The supplier’s bank details have been verified.
questions.explanation: L’accusé de réception porte sur la relance, pas sur le règlement ou l’acceptation de la dette. Il faut conserver l’objet exact de la confirmation.

questions.q: An email uses a firm professional tone. A writer describes it as a formal legal notice solely because it sounds serious. Which assessment is justified?
options: Mentioning an overdue balance alone establishes that legal status.
Its legal status requires examination beyond tone alone.
The word urgent in the subject line alone establishes that legal status.
Attaching an invoice alone establishes that legal status.
questions.explanation: Le ton ne suffit pas à qualifier juridiquement un message. Une relance professionnelle doit être distinguée d’une démarche formelle dont les conditions demandent une analyse spécifique.
